_comment: PLACEHOLDER: sample reader notes so every comment state can be seen. Keyed by post slug. Remove or replace once a real comments backend is connected. 'byPoet' marks Bita's own replies. 'quote' is the line a note responds to.

iron-gall.author: Maren
iron-gall.body: I read this on my phone on the train and then went home and found an old fountain pen just to watch the ink change.

iron-gall.author: Jonah
iron-gall.body: “the colour of a leaf that kept its shape” is going on the inside cover of my notebook.

iron-gall.author: Bita Shaban
iron-gall.body: That is exactly where it belongs. Thank you, Jonah.

inventory-of-a-small-house.author: Ilse
inventory-of-a-small-house.body: Our fourth stair speaks too. I have never once thought of it as a poem until now.

inventory-of-a-small-house.author: Tomás
inventory-of-a-small-house.body: The way the last section walks down the page. I had to scroll slowly. I think that was the point.

inventory-of-a-small-house.author: Bita Shaban
inventory-of-a-small-house.body: It was. It took me eleven drafts to let it take up the page.

inventory-of-a-small-house.author: Ada
inventory-of-a-small-house.body: “like a guest who has been here before / and knows where the cups are”. Yes.

the-night-bus.author: Kit
the-night-bus.body: I drove a night bus for six years. This is the first thing I have read that gets the depot right.

the-night-bus.author: Noor
the-night-bus.body: The cold climbing in to look around and deciding not to stay. I will think of this every winter now.

on-leaving-a-word-out.author: Wren
on-leaving-a-word-out.body: I teach a poetry workshop on Thursdays and I would love to read this to them. The drawer of buttons is perfect.

on-leaving-a-word-out.author: Bita Shaban
on-leaving-a-word-out.body: Please do. Tell them to bring their own buttons.

fragments-from-a-winter-notebook.author: Sol
fragments-from-a-winter-notebook.body: Number three. That is the whole of January in seven words.
fragments-from-a-winter-notebook.quote: My breath leaves before I do.

rain-descending.author: Hester
rain-descending.body: Read this with the window open while it was actually raining. Recommended.

instructions-for-keeping-a-lamp.author: Leon
instructions-for-keeping-a-lamp.body: We leave a lamp on in the hall when we go away. Now I know why.

instructions-for-keeping-a-lamp.author: Priya
instructions-for-keeping-a-lamp.body: “It will start to read you back.” A small shiver.

things-i-have-mistaken-for-birds.author: Ada
things-i-have-mistaken-for-birds.body: The glove on the railing. I have seen that exact glove. Everyone has.

things-i-have-mistaken-for-birds.author: Maren
things-i-have-mistaken-for-birds.body: The ending turned the whole list around for me. I went back to the top and read it again as a list of things she did not let go of.

insomnia.author: Noor
insomnia.body: Read at 3:40 in the morning. Accurate.

letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.author: Hester
letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.body: There are pencil heights inside our pantry door too, from a family we never met. We never painted over them either.
letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.quote: a ladder of heights in pencil,

letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.author: Bita Shaban
letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.body: Then this letter is for her too.

letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.author: Tomás
letter-to-the-woman-who-lived-here-befor.body: Signing it “the new woman” undid me a little.
